name: Atlas of the Seven Skies
subtitle: Atlas of the Seven Skies
summary: A navigational overview of the continents, seas, and major powers across the setting.

hotspots.name: First Empire
hotspots.summary: The heart of the ancient empire, still home to its towers and scholarly institutions.
hotspots.description: Highland cities circle Rondich, where surviving imperial archives and court workshops still cluster.
facts: The archive towers preserve complete old-calendar codices
Imperial roads still form the military backbone
Most royal cadet lines now live in the outer city

hotspots.name: Trailan Kingdom
hotspots.summary: A kingdom that rose after the fractured crown era, famed for forest taxes and iron trade.
hotspots.description: Trailan controls the eastern passages through wooded mountain gates and maintains a mobile corps of forest riders.
facts: Its capital hosts the Lunar Archive
It keeps a fragile pact with northern tribes
Eastern ports produce renowned glasswork

name: First Empire
subtitle: Unna Empire
summary: A highland imperial core shaped by the old capital and the academy towers.

hotspots.name: Rondich
hotspots.summary: The old capital where imperial ritual still survives among towers and councils.
hotspots.description: Seven layers of walls encircle the palace ridge, and the inner city remains home to scribes, artisans, and descendants of the old court.
facts: The central tower overlooks the entire city
Imperial investitures are still held here
Murals of the fire wars remain on public walls

hotspots.name: Sky Archive Tower
hotspots.summary: The academic core that preserves world atlases and the old calendrical records.
hotspots.description: Its levels are divided into royal history, naval charts, and prophecy archives, with access restricted by council warrants.
facts: Metal plates mark the archive levels
The top floor houses an observatory disk
Copying maps is the rite of passage for apprentices

hotspots.name: Ember Gate
hotspots.summary: A fortress and customs station guarding the southern highland road.
hotspots.description: The gate serves trade and military traffic alike, and every southern caravan must register cargo and perform the fire rite here.
facts: The watch fire is lit every day
It holds the most complete imperial armory
The only stone bridge toward the southern salt road is controlled here

name: Trailan Kingdom
subtitle: Trailan Kingdom
summary: A forest monarchy built on mountains, iron, and the Lunar Archive.

hotspots.name: Lunar Archive
hotspots.summary: A terrace archive that preserves treaties and land grants of the eastern realm.
hotspots.description: Its outer walls are inlaid with moon-silver stone, and the collection is physically reordered at each new moon.
facts: New moon nights host public treaty readings
Records reach back to frontier negotiations before the fractured crown era
Its silver masonry doubles as a navigation marker

hotspots.name: Glass Harbor
hotspots.summary: A harbor city known for glass and dye production.
hotspots.description: It exports deep-blue glass and seaweed dyes and acts as the kingdom's principal gateway to the outer sea.
facts: The harbor office also runs a lighthouse school
Coastal workshops craft star-reading lenses
A seven-night lantern festival is held each winter

hotspots.name: Stag Pass
hotspots.summary: A wooded frontier corridor patrolled by the forest riders.
hotspots.description: Dense woodland presses against a cliffside road here, forming the shortest route between the eastern kingdom and the north.
facts: Winter travel is restricted to daylight
Hunting bells line the mountain trail
The cliff walls bear migration carvings from ancient tribes
